title: Effects of Listening to Binaural Beats on Anxiety and Pain Scores in Males Undergoing Cystoscopy and Stent Removal
brief_summary: This study aimed to investigate the effects of pure binaural beats on anxiety levels and pain scores using the State-Trait Anxiety Inventory (STAI) questionnaire and Visual Analog Scale (VAS) in male patients undergoing DC and USR procedures under local anesthesia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male patient
* negative urine culture
* at least formal schooling (1-8 y of education)

Exclusion Criteria:

* hearing or vision problems
* neurological deficits
* mental retardation
* history of chronic pelvic pain syndrome
* history of previous DC or USR procedures
* antidepressant use or analgesia use 24 h before the procedure
* decline to participate
